mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 falls below -2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.10) when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE above 3.5% within the same month indicates a situation of stagnant employment but rising labor force participation, which compresses wage growth and supports corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS falls and UNRATE exceeds 3.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for two consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces revenue expectations for cyclicals and drags down the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of episodes where INDPRO is below its 12M MA by more than 3% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in HOUST below its 6-month moving average by more than 10% signals weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and home-related equities and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.10) when HOUST falls more than 10% below its 6M MA.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL below 1.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy with subdued inflation, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL < 1.5% for 2 months
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls below 1.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in RSAFS below its 12-month moving average by more than 5% for four consecutive months signals weakening retail sales momentum, which reduces consumer spending expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of episodes where RSAFS is below its 12M MA by more than 5% for four consecutive months.
